facts.fact: 1999：瑞典放射科医生 Anna Bågenholm 在挪威 Narvik 滑雪——坠入冰封溪流。
facts.anchor: a Swedish radiologist named Anna Bågenholm went skiing in the mountains near Narvik, Norway.

facts.fact: 水下 80 分钟——核心体温 13.7°C：幸存者最低纪录。
facts.anchor: had been submerged in freezing water for 80 minutes

facts.fact: 心跳已停、无生命迹象——但没有被宣布死亡。
facts.anchor: Her heart had stopped. She showed no signs of life.

facts.fact: 医生持续复温、体外循环——心跳重新跳动；数天后醒来近乎完全康复。
facts.anchor: they worked to slowly rewarm her body, circulating her blood through external machines

facts.fact: 医学原则：「你直到温暖且死亡才算死。」
facts.anchor: “You’re not dead until you’re warm and dead.”

facts.fact: 冷水里死亡不总是立即——有时根本不会来。
facts.anchor: Sometimes, it never comes at all.
